    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public enum EInputFileCategory
extends java.lang.Enum<EInputFileCategory>
    Wrapper enum for the workflow internal EInputFileCategory.
    Following input file categories are generally available. (To retrieve all available file categories for a specific input file, use IInputFileApi.getAvailableFileCategories()
